name: inite-brain
description: Persistent, bitemporal memory for Claude Code: the MCP tool surface, six skills that teach the model to use it, recall injected at session start, and capture before compaction.

api_key.title: Brain API key (optional, for the session hooks)
api_key.description: Only the session hooks use it: recall at session start and capture before compaction call brain's REST API with this key. The brain tools and the per-prompt recall sign in with your INITE account instead (Claude asks the first time memory is used). Issue a key at https://brain.inite.ai/en/app/keys — it starts with brain_ and is shown once.

base_url.title: Brain base URL
base_url.description: Where the session hooks send recall and capture requests. Change only for a self-hosted deployment, and add your own server's /mcp URL as an MCP server too.

user_id.title: Personal memory scope (optional)
user_id.description: Tags what the hooks write and read with this end-user id, so a shared workspace key still keeps your memory yours — and brain files what you say in the first person under you, so "what did I ask for" later means you. Leave empty to use the workspace-wide scope.

recall_on_start.title: Recall at session start
recall_on_start.description: Inject what brain already knows about this project into the first turn.

capture_sessions.title: Capture sessions into memory
capture_sessions.description: Send what you asked for (your messages, never the model's own output) to brain before compaction and at session end, so the next session starts informed.

recall_each_prompt.title: Recall on every prompt
recall_each_prompt.description: Look each prompt up in brain before the model reads it and attach what comes back as context (at most 2.5 s per prompt; nothing is attached when brain is slow or finds nothing). Needs a Claude Code version with mods; older versions keep the session-start recall alone.
